summary.text: Sarah Huckabee Sanders is the incumbent Republican Governor of Arkansas, seeking a second term. A former White House press secretary under President Trump, she was elected in 2022 with about 63% of the vote. Her first term included the LEARNS Act, which created the state's school voucher program, and income-tax rate cuts signed in 2023 and 2026.

paragraphs.text: Served as White House press secretary in the first Trump administration; her father, Mike Huckabee, was Governor of Arkansas from 1996 to 2007.
Elected governor in 2022 with 62.96% of the vote.
